article.title: Punishment for sexual harassment.
article.content: Whoever, commits sexual harassment upon a child shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
article.html:
12Punishment for sexual harassment.

Section 12 · Chapter II · Sexual Harassment and Punishment Therefor · page 8 of the Act

Whoever, commits sexual harassment upon a child shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.
